scope: Production code (src/, action.yml, package.json) and production-relevant workflows. Tests, CI helpers and local tooling excluded.
method: Manual code review against 8 fixed categories, whole-number 0-10 per category, overall = sum/80*100.

critical_issues.title: Untrusted PR titles and commit messages are emitted verbatim in step outputs (lead-time-log, deploy-rate-log)
evidence: README.md WARNING: consumers must not interpolate *-log outputs into run: scripts
critical_issues.impact: Any contributor to a monitored repo controls text that lands in a GitHub Actions output; consumers that interpolate it into run: get shell/expression injection in their job context.
critical_issues.why_it_matters: Only mitigation is a README warning; no sanitization or bounding in code.

critical_issues.title: Silent fallback to unauthenticated GitHub API when no token is supplied
evidence: src/index.ts: token = core.getInput('token') || process.env.GH_TOKEN with no definedness check
all adapters: new Octokit({ auth: this.token }) with token: string | undefined
action.yml: token input required: false, no default
critical_issues.impact: Anonymous requests: private repos return 404 -> metrics silently become 0; public repos hit 60 req/h limit.
critical_issues.why_it_matters: Misconfiguration produces plausible but wrong output instead of failing closed.

critical_issues.title: Token from GH_TOKEN env fallback is never registered with core.setSecret
evidence: src/index.ts reads process.env.GH_TOKEN; no setSecret usage anywhere in src/
critical_issues.impact: Token not masked in logs if sourced outside the secrets.* context.
critical_issues.why_it_matters: setSecret is the standard zero-cost defence.

critical_issues.title: API-supplied commits_url is fetched with the bearer token and no host allowlist
evidence: src/CommitsAdapter.ts: octokit.request(url, ...) with a full URL from the PR payload
critical_issues.impact: Code trusts response data to decide where an authenticated request is sent; practical exploitability very low.
critical_issues.why_it_matters: Defence in depth at zero functional cost.

critical_issues.title: No throttling, retry, or workload bounds on GitHub API usage
evidence: src/index.ts: repositories list has no maximum
adapters: up to 99 pages x 100 items per resource per repo
src/LeadTime.ts: one commits request per qualifying PR, sequential, uncapped
critical_issues.impact: Can exhaust GITHUB_TOKEN rate limit -> partial data and starved later steps.
critical_issues.why_it_matters: Read-only action, so availability/accuracy impact, but bounds are absent.

critical_issues.title: Inputs owner, repo and bug-label are not validated beyond non-empty
evidence: owner and bugLabel passed straight through
critical_issues.impact: Octokit URL-encodes route params so traversal is not achievable; residual effect is opaque API errors.
critical_issues.why_it_matters: No boundary validation layer; protection is incidental to a dependency.

recommendations.action: Sanitize and bound *-log output content; emit as JSON array.
recommendations.reason: Moves protection from docs into code.

recommendations.action: Fail fast without a token; call core.setSecret; default token to github.token in action.yml.
recommendations.reason: Eliminates silent anonymous mode; ensures masking.

recommendations.action: Add @octokit/plugin-throttling + plugin-retry; bound repos and commit fetches; stop paginating outside the window.
recommendations.reason: Prevents rate-limit exhaustion and partial results.

recommendations.action: Assert api.github.com host or rebuild the commits route from owner/repo/number.
recommendations.reason: Avoids forwarding the bearer token to a response-chosen URL.

recommendations.action: Wrap adapter errors with a fixed message + status instead of forwarding e.message.
Keep SHA-pinned actions, persist-credentials:false, check-dist, Dependabot, CodeQL, dependency overrides; add permissions: contents: read to README example.
recommendations.reason: Supply chain already strong; nudge consumers to least privilege.

scope: Production code (src/, action.yml, package.json) and production-relevant workflows. Tests, CI helpers and local tooling excluded.
method: Manual code review against 8 fixed categories, whole-number 0-10 per category, overall = sum/80*100.

category_notes.authorization_access_control: Action is read-only by construction; README usage example carries a contents/pull-requests/issues: read block and GITHUB_TOKEN vs fine-grained PAT guidance; dora.yaml reference consumer runs the action with a read-only token and confines contents: write to the history job. Residual: the action cannot verify the scope of the token it is handed.
category_notes.authentication_token_validation: parseInputs fails fast when neither the token input nor GH_TOKEN is set, registers the token with core.setSecret, and action.yml defaults token to github.token; 401 is not retried. Residual: no pre-flight token check, a bad token surfaces as a GitHubApiError (status 401) on the first request.
category_notes.input_validation_boundary_hardening: owner/repo validated against an anchored name regex (1-100 chars, no '..'), owner/name entries must agree with the owner input, at most 25 repositories, bug-label trimmed and bounded to 50 chars, flags accept only the literal 'true'. API payloads cross an anti-corruption layer (src/github/mappers.ts) before reaching metrics. Residual: payload shapes are trusted structurally (TypeScript only, no runtime schema).
category_notes.injection_safety_query_construction: Every request is a 'METHOD /route' template with Octokit params (URL-encoded); GitHubClient.request refuses anything else so a response-supplied URL can never carry the token; commits are fetched by owner/repo/number. All *-log outputs are sanitized (control chars, backticks, ${ and $( openers removed; 200-char cap) and bounded (500 records / <1 MiB) JSON arrays; metrics-status and the four metric outputs are numeric or action-built. Residual: a consumer can still interpolate outputs into run:, which the README explicitly warns against with an env-var pattern.
category_notes.data_integrity_atomicity_auditability: Outputs are set only after all three listings succeeded, so a failed run leaves no partial outputs; releases/issues are matched by exact lower-cased owner/repo key; one MetricsWindow is shared by every adapter and metric; empty data yields 0 plus a warning and a metrics-status record instead of a throw. Residual: results truncated by the 99-page cap are only signalled by a warning, not reflected in metrics-status.
category_notes.information_disclosure_error_handling: Adapter failures are wrapped in GitHubApiError with a stable, URL/body-free message (status + route template); only index.ts calls setFailed, and the raw Octokit message goes to core.error where the token is already masked. Log text is sanitized before it reaches an output. Residual: validation errors echo the offending input value (authored by the workflow owner, so low risk).
category_notes.abuse_prevention_rate_limiting_operation: Octokit throttling + retry plugins (primary limit waited out once, secondary limit never retried, 5xx/network retried with backoff); bounds on repositories (25), pages per listing (99), commit fetches (200 at concurrency 4); pagination stops at the window edge so a typical run costs tens of requests; remaining rate limit logged. Residual: no total request or time budget, and onRateLimit may sleep until the reset (up to ~1 h) before giving up.
category_notes.secrets_secure_configuration: Token masked via setSecret, token defaults to github.token, workflows SHA-pinned with persist-credentials: false, check-dist verifies the bundle, Dependabot (actions + npm, 7-day cooldown), CodeQL, qs/undici overrides, npm audit --omit=dev clean. Residual: badges.yaml and stryker.yaml still grant contents: write at workflow level; the unused 'octokit' meta-package is still a production dependency; package.json metadata is still the template's.

resolved_since_baseline.title: Untrusted PR titles and commit messages are emitted verbatim in step outputs
resolved_since_baseline.evidence: src/sanitize.ts + src/log.ts; *-log outputs are sanitized, bounded JSON arrays (v2.0.0).

resolved_since_baseline.title: Silent fallback to unauthenticated GitHub API when no token is supplied
resolved_since_baseline.evidence: src/main.ts parseInputs throws TOKEN_REQUIRED_MESSAGE; action.yml token default github.token.

resolved_since_baseline.title: Token from GH_TOKEN env fallback is never registered with core.setSecret
API-supplied commits_url is fetched with the bearer token and no host allowlist
resolved_since_baseline.evidence: src/CommitsAdapter.ts builds GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/commits; GitHubClient.request rejects non-route URLs.

resolved_since_baseline.title: No throttling, retry, or workload bounds on GitHub API usage
resolved_since_baseline.evidence: src/GitHubClient.ts plugins + limits; maxRepositories(); defaultLeadTimeLimits(); window-based pagination stop.

resolved_since_baseline.title: Inputs owner, repo and bug-label are not validated beyond non-empty

recommendations.action: Reflect a hit page cap in metrics-status (e.g. "partial") instead of only a warning.
recommendations.reason: Consumers can currently not tell a complete 0 from a truncated listing without reading the log.

recommendations.action: Cap the primary-rate-limit wait (or fail fast with a clear message) and consider an overall request budget per run.
recommendations.reason: A single retry may stall the job until the hourly reset.

recommendations.action: Apply the dora.yaml job split (read-only workflow permissions, contents: write on the push job only) to badges.yaml and stryker.yaml.
recommendations.reason: Same least-privilege pattern, already proven green.

recommendations.action: Drop the unused 'octokit' meta-package from dependencies and replace the template metadata in package.json.
recommendations.reason: Smaller dependency surface and accurate provenance.
